arguments.sql_query:
WITH af_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 313217
  UNION SELECT 313217
),
af AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS af_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN af_concepts ac ON co.condition_concept_id = ac.concept_id
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
eligible_af AS (
  SELECT af.person_id, af.af_date
  FROM af
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = af.person_id
   AND op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, af.af_date)
   AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 90, af.af_date)
),
anti_ingredients AS (
  SELECT 1310149 AS ingredient_id, 'Warfarin' AS anticoagulant_class
  UNION ALL SELECT 43013024, 'DOAC'
  UNION ALL SELECT 40241331, 'DOAC'
  UNION ALL SELECT 45775372, 'DOAC'
  UNION ALL SELECT 45892847, 'DOAC'
  UNION ALL SELECT 1367571, 'Heparin/LMWH'
  UNION ALL SELECT 1301025, 'Heparin/LMWH'
),
anti_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, ai.anticoagulant_class
  FROM anti_ingredients ai
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ai.ingredient_id
),
first_anti AS (
  SELECT person_id, af_date, anticoagulant_class, drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM (
    SELECT ea.person_id, ea.af_date, ad.anticoagulant_class, de.drug_exposure_start_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ea.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_exposure_start_date,
             CASE ad.anticoagulant_class WHEN 'DOAC' THEN 1 WHEN 'Warfarin' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS rn
    FROM eligible_af ea
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = ea.person_id
      AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= ea.af_date
      AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 30, ea.af_date)
    JOIN anti_drugs ad ON ad.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
),
stroke_tia_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4310996, 381316, 373503)
  UNION SELECT 4310996 UNION SELECT 381316 UNION SELECT 373503
),
bleed_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 437312
  UNION SELECT 437312
),
events AS (
  SELECT fa.person_id, fa.anticoagulant_class,
         MAX(CASE WHEN st.concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stroke_tia_90d,
         MAX(CASE WHEN bc.concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bleed_90d
  FROM first_anti fa
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = fa.person_id
    AND co.condition_start_date > fa.start_date
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, fa.start_date)
  LEFT JOIN stroke_tia_concepts st ON st.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN bleed_concepts bc ON bc.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  GROUP BY fa.person_id, fa.anticoagulant_class
)
SELECT anticoagulant_class,
       COUNT(*) AS patients,
       SUM(stroke_tia_90d) AS stroke_tia_events,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(stroke_tia_90d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS stroke_tia_rate_pct,
       SUM(bleed_90d) AS bleeding_events,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(bleed_90d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS bleeding_rate_pct
FROM events
GROUP BY anticoagulant_class
ORDER BY anticoagulant_class;

Using OMOP EHR data, I defined new AF as each patient’s first atrial fibrillation condition record, required ≥365 days prior and ≥90 days follow-up observation, and classified the first anticoagulant within 30 days as DOAC, warfarin, or heparin/LMWH.

| Initial anticoagulant class | N | 90-day stroke/TIA | Rate | 90-day bleeding | Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| DOAC | 4,081 | 213 | 5.22% | 262 | 6.42% |
| Heparin/LMWH | 10,269 | 727 | 7.08% | 1,873 | 18.24% |
| Warfarin | 579 | 56 | 9.67% | 81 | 13.99% |

Notes: DOAC included apixaban, rivaroxaban, dabigatran, and edoxaban. Outcomes were condition-code based within 90 days after initial anticoagulant start. These are crude observed rates, not adjusted for confounding or indication severity.
